agreements_v1: metallic liquid swirls, golden vertical streak with green tint, bright lower centre, darker left side

misses.observed: v1 about 40% too dark over time (luma 0.24 vs 0.42)
misses.cause: the two custom waves are spectrum-mode (bSpectrum=1); spectrum values were not modelled, so value1 was missing. diagnostics.composite: our composite on the ruler canvas: red 0.596 vs ruler display 0.540
diagnostics.early_frames: fresh drawing at frames 0-3: ours 60% of the engine, lines vertical instead of curved

misses.scope: 2229 bundled presets have spectrum-mode custom waves

general_fixes_v2: spectrum-mode custom waves: value1/value2 read the engine spectrum of the declared PCM window (projectM PCM::UpdateSpectrum + MilkdropFFT: two-tap damping, 480-sample envelope, 1024-point FFT, -0.02*ln((512-i)/512) equalisation), resampled by (512-sep)/samples, smoothed and scaled by 0.15*scaling*waveScale
engine per-point inputs (value1, value2, sample) are never treated as main per-frame state
